title: erigeron stellatus
intro: Erigeron stellatus, commonly known as daisy fleabane, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Erigeron stellatus include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron stellatus include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of calming and protecting the body.
